parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS edge zone.

parameters.name: InstanceBillingCycle
parameters.description: The billing cycle of the instance. Valid values: Hour and Month.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The NAT gateway specification. Valid value: **enat.default**.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the NAT gateway. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

- Cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.
- Can be up to 64 characters in length.
- Cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://.
